name: Jack Reed
bio: The 2026 United States Senate election in Rhode Island will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Rhode Island. Primary elections will be held on Wednesday, September 9, 2026. Incumbent Democratic senator Jack Reed is running for re-election. The state has been represented exclusively by Democrats since 2007 and is considered safely Democratic; Republicans have not won a U.S. Senate election since 2000.
